tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: klu bdud kyi zhags pa dgu 'grol bzhugs so:

slob dpon pad+ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: 'gro ba sems can gyi don du klu bdud kyi zhags pa dgu 'grol 'di mdzad do: 'di yi gsog la dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa ling tshe dgu byas la: dbus sngo nag: shar dkar: lho sngo: nub dmar: byang ljang: mtshams bzhi nag po: tha ma ser pos bskor ba bris la: de'i mthar chu ris sngon po: mtha' skor nag po: de'i mthar shing ris dang: gling bzhi gling phran la sogs pas bskor bas: rten sogs 'jim pa la ling tshe dgu'i steng du dkyil 'khor spe'u gcig: logs spe bzhi: zur spe bzhi bkod la: ling tshe dgu'i steng gi spe'u dgu'i steng du rta pa nag po dgu bzhag: nam mkha' gong sngon mtha' nag dgu: ljang gu sngo nag dgu: mda' ltong ser: 'phang nag g.yu lo can: pho gdong rnams dgu re: 'bru sogs la bshos bu nag po dgu: glang nag: g.yag nag: bya nag: khyi nag: lug nag: sbrul khra: sbal khra: nya khra: lcong khra: sdig pa khra bo rnams dgu dgu spe'u dgu po la bkod: nad pa dang bza' tshang du yod kyi dri ma bsgos pa'i glud nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyis mtha' la bskor: spos chu dang: gser skyems dang: dkar gsum dang: mngar gsum: dmar gsum: spyan gzigs sna tshogs bshams: snang srid lha 'dre thams cad la tshe gzhi gcig kyang bsham: rta pa nag po dgu'i tong tshe re re rta pa re la gtad: sne mo ngos gcig thams cad nad pa'i ske la btags pa: klu bdud re la thag pa re 'grol: lcung ka'i sgros nad pa la byab la ngar glud la bstim mo: chu gtor gcig kyang gtong ngo: 1$0000230 de nas rta mgrin: phyag rdor bya khyung gsum gang rung gi phrin gzhung bsrang: rang yi dam du bsgoms la gyer ro:1$0000300 kyai: dang po stong pa'i ngang nyid las: de la rdul dang rdul phran chags: de steng gser gyi sa gzhi chags: de la ri rab lhun po srid: gling bzhi gling phran brgyad kyis bskor: rgyu ni rin chen 'byung ba lnga la brten:

gling ni khyad 'phags dzam bu gling: dbyibs ni sog kha brdal ba 'dra: lha srin sde brgyad gnas kyang bcas: skye 'gro mi la gnod par byed: yas su mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul: kyai: sde brgyad nang nas gdug rtsub can: klu bdud nag po mched dgu byung: brag dang chu mig sbrel ma dang: lung gsum 'dus pa'i mdo la gnas: brag dang rtsi shing dag la gnas: gnod pa mi dang phyugs la gnod: de la yas dang glud 'bul gyi: rin chen sna lnga'i dkyil 'khor du: dug sbrul bsgyel pa'i gdan steng du: jo bo klu bdud spyan 'dren glud la gshegs: mthun rdzas sna tshogs 'di ltar mchis: dgu tshan yas dang glud bshams shing: spyan gzigs gser skyems phud rgod la: klu bdud spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: phyag na rdo rje'i bka' byung bas: sbrul nag 'khyil pa'i gdan steng du: jo bo klu bdud bzhugs su gsol: jo bo klu bdud mched dgu la: bdag cag ma rig 'khrul dbang gis: thugs dang 'gal pa ci mchis pa: 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags: jo bo klu bdud mched dgu la: dgyes pa'i sku glud 'bul ba ni: dgu tshan mang po bsags mdos dang: ting 'dzin gsal bas byin gyis brlabs: sngags dang phyag rgyas mos par bsgyur: bden pa'i tshig gis bkrol zhing bshad: 'dod yon lnga ldan mdos mchog 'di: klu bdud 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhes su gsol: zhags pas bcings pa 'grol du gsol: phyag na rdo rje'i bka' ma gcog: sngon gyi lan chags yod na yang: mthun pa'i yas dang glud 'di 'bul: dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhes su gsol: mdos bdag chen pos mdos bzhes shig: glud bdag chen pos glud bzhes shig: gnod pa'i gdug rtsub zhi bar mdzod:1$0000230 de nas byad thag zhags pa 'grol ba ni:1$0000300 kyai: klu bdud mgo dgu'i gcen po ba: klu bdud nag po ti pa tsa: 1$0000250❀1$0000300 dpon g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa la:

mthun pa'i yas glud 'di ltar 'bul: sku mkhar rgyan dang ldan pa dang: mi nag dang ni rta nag dang: nam mkha' nag po rgyang nag dang: mda' nag dang ni 'phang nag dang: pho gdong bzhin legs 'dzum shor dang: bshos bu nag po 'brang rgyas dang: glang nag g.yag nag bya nag dang: khyi nag dang ni lug nag dang: sbrul nag dang ni sbal pa sngo khra dang: nya dang lcong mo sdig pa dang: ngar glud spos chab gser skyems dang: dkar gsum mngar gsum dmar gsum dang: rtsi sman spyan gzigs che dgu 'bul: mdos bdag chen pos mdos bzhes shig: glud bdag chen pos glud bzhes shig: rgyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po 'di: zhags pas bcings pa bkrol du gsol: gdug pa'i nad rnams zhi bar mdzod: phyag na rdo rje'i bka' ma gcog: sa ma ya la gnas par gyis: rang rang so so'i gnas su gshegs:1$0000230 yi dam gyi sngags la sham bu 'di sbyar ba bzla zhing rol mo/ 1$0000300klu bdud gdug pa'i nad thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā:1$0000230 de 'og ma kun la 'gre'o//) zhes srad bu nad pa'i mgul las bkrol nas rta pa gcig la gtad: gong gi sngags bzla bzhin/ skyung ka'i sgros nad pa la byabs la ngar glud la bstim mo: 1$0000300kyai: klu bdud de yi gcung po ba: klu bdud nag po 'dzin shes gtong mi shes: dpon g.yog 1$0000230sogs 'gre'o// 1$0000300kyai: klu bdud de yi gcung po ba: klu bdud khrims ldan ral pa can: dpon g.yog= kyai: klu bdud de yi gcung po ba: klu bdud rta dgu mkhar lding legs: dpon g.yog= kyai: klu bdud de yi gcung po ba: klu bdud 'gram nag ma gcig lags: dpon g.yog= kyai: klu bdud de yi gcung po ba: klu bdud gtsang pa mgo dgu lags: dpon g.yog= kyai: klu bdud de yi gcung po ba: klu bdud sdig pa'i mgo bo can: dpon g.yog= kyai: klu bdud de yi gcung po ba: klu bdud gel ba glang gi mgo bo can:

dpon g.yog= kyai: klu bdud de yi gcung po ba: klu bdud snyab pa lag ring lags: dpon g.yog=1$0000230 de nas glud bsngo ba ni: 1$0000300kyai: jo bo klu bdud 'khor bcas la: ngar glud nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'di: rgyu sbyor yon bdag glud du 'bul: klu bdud khyed kyi spyan lam du: glud mchog 'di ni khyad par 'phags: 'bru mchog ngar gyi mi bo che: ku ba'i mgo la zer mo'i skra: lung thang mig la 'gron bu'i so: rgya dar lce la zangs ma'i sna: gro ga gcus pa'i rna ba can: zho sha'i don snying bse chen sha: mtshal gyi khrag la dung gi rus: rkang g.yas lcags la rkang g.yon zangs: lag pa g.yas su gser ba bskur: lag pa g.yon du g.yu bskur nas: rgyu sbyor yon bdag glud du 'bul: glud bdag lags kyis glud bzhes shig: bzung pa thongs la bcings pa khrol: kyai: jo bo klu bdud rnams da ni gshegs mdzod cig: ri gsum 'dus pa'i rtse la gshegs: lung gsum 'dus pa'i phu ru gshegs: brag nag do ba'i rtse ru gshegs: shing nag rkang gcig rtsa ru gshegs: chu mgo dgu yi rtsa ru gshegs: rang rang so so'i gnas su gshegs: phyag na rdo rje'i bka' ma gcog: sa ma ya la gnas par gyis: yon bdag 'di la ma gnod par: khyod kyang dam la ma 'da' zhig: nga yang dam las mi 'da' 'o: mdos bdag mdos bzhes shig: glud bdag glud bzhes shig: phyogs mtshams rang rang bde bar bzhud:1$0000230 ces brjod la spang leb bam phub kyi khar sngar yod pa bzhin bzhag la: gnod phyogs su yas bskyal lo: 'di lan gsum byas na klu bdud ji ltar 'gras che yang nad las grol bar nges so: bsam yas mchims phu'i gter ma'o// maṅga laṃ/// / 1$0000300 ༈ mnga' bdag nyang gi gter mar grags pa'i klu bdud zhags pa dgu 'grol 'di la bcas bsham dang cho ga gzhung gsal ltar la/ bdag bskyed rta phyag khyung gsum gang rung byas kyang rung*// phyag len la nā ga rak+sha mdzad pas/

de'i las byang sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus gang rigs dang*/ bzlas pa ci nus bya/ chu gtor zhig gtang gsungs pa sna sel lta bu yin 'dug pas sde brgyad gser skyems gtang yang rung*/ de nas nad pa mdun du 'khod pa la byad thag mgul lam srin lag la sbrel/ gtor yas rnams sngags drug phyag drug gis brlabs la/ kyai: dang po stong pa'i ngang nyid las: zhes sogs nas mthar phyungs/ yas glud bskyal ba dang mnyam du/ nā ga rak+sha'i sngags dang*/ sum+bha ni sogs drag sngags brjod la bskrad/ srung 'khor spyi 'gro bsgom/ bkra shis rgyas par brjod do/ ༈ /yang phyag len rgyas pa dbang dang 'brel bar byed na/ yar gzhi la/ nā ga rak+sha'i dbang dkyil gzhung ltar dang khrus bum kyang bsham/ bdag mdun dbyer med dam so sor bsgrub/ las bum du nā ga rak+sha gsal ba'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs par bsam la bzlas pa dang 'od zhu bcas bya/ gtor ma 'bul/ de nas cho ga gzhan gong ltar la/ byad thag bkrol tshar nas/ bum pa thogs la/ nā ga rak+sha'i sngags kyi mthar/ sbyin pa'i bdag pos tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags klu gnyan sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bkru ba dang*/ a pa na ye swā hā btags pas byab pa sogs byab khrus spyi ltar rgyas bsdus gang mos bya/ de nas/ kyai: jo bo klu bdud 'khor bcas la: sogs glud bsngo/ yas bskyal bskrad sngags dang*/ srung 'khor tshar nas/ sngags mthar/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa btags pa'i srung ba spyi ltar bya/ de nas rjes gnang dang gtor dbang bcas bya zhing shis brjod rgyas par bya'o// maṅga laṃ/// /
